records.jp: あれ、ここ…………？
records.en_original: This is...
records.en_auxiliary: This is...
records.en: This is...

records.jp: 宮内さんのココロトープで見た、<CR>展望台の場所……ですよね？
records.en_original: This is the observation deck that was in Miyauchi's Heartscape... Isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: This is the observation deck that was in Miyauchi's Heartscape... Isn't it?
records.en: This is the observation deck that was in Miyauchi-san's Heartscape... Isn't it?

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: Y-yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah...
records.en: Y-yeah...

records.jp: （あれ、なんでここに……？）
records.en_original: (Why is it here...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Why is it here...?)
records.en: (Why is it here...?)

records.jp: この音は…………？
records.en_original: That sound...
records.en_auxiliary: That sound...
records.en: That sound...

records.jp: ここにいると……<CR>どんどん記憶が流れ込んでくるんだよ
records.en_original: The longer I'm in this place, the more the memories come flooding back.
records.en_auxiliary: The longer I'm in this place, the more the memories come flooding back.
records.en: The longer I'm in this place, the more the memories come flooding back.

records.jp: 勇希……？
records.en_original: Yuki...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...?
records.en: Yuki...?

records.jp: そ、そりゃそうだよ。<CR>ここはココロトープなんだから……
records.en_original: W-well it is your Heartscape after all...
records.en_auxiliary: W-well it is your Heartscape after all...
records.en: W-well it is your Heartscape after all...

records.jp: ……そうだね
records.en_original: You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right.
records.en: You're right.

records.jp: でも、あたしの記憶は……
records.en_original: But these memories...
records.en_auxiliary: But these memories...
records.en: But these memories...

records.jp: 思い出したくなかった。<CR>こんなことなら、ずっと忘れたままが、よかったのに
records.en_original: I didn't want to remember. I wanted to forget them forever.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't want to remember. I wanted to forget them forever.
records.en: I didn't want to remember. I wanted to forget them forever.

records.jp: な、何が言いたいの！？<CR>はっきり言ってくれないと分かんないよ！
records.en_original: Wh-what are you trying to say?! Stop being so vague!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you trying to say?! Stop being so vague!
records.en: Wh-what are you trying to say?! Stop being so vague!

records.jp: ねえ、みんな。<CR>みんなは、本当にあたしの灰病が治ったと思う？
records.en_original: Do you all really think that I got better?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you all really think that I got better?
records.en: Do you all really think that I got better?

records.jp: 何を、言ってるの……？
records.en_original: What are you implying...?
records.en_auxiliary: What are you implying...?
records.en: What are you implying...?

records.jp: 伶那。あなたは、本当に自分が<CR>灰病を治す方法を見つけたって思ってる？
records.en_original: Rena. Do you really believe that you found a way to cure me?
records.en_auxiliary: Rena. Do you really believe that you found a way to cure me?
records.en: Rena. Do you really believe that you found a way to cure me?

records.jp: そんな都合のいい奇跡、本当に起きたと思う？
records.en_original: Do you think that miracles like that really happen?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you think that miracles like that really happen?
records.en: Do you think that miracles like that really happen?

records.jp: あたし、嘘つきなんだ
records.en_original: I lied to you all.
records.en_auxiliary: I lied to you all.
records.en: I lied to you all.

records.jp: あたしはこの世界に来る前……<CR>すでに死んでるんだ
records.en_original: I was dead before I even came to this world.
records.en_auxiliary: I was dead before I even came to this world.
records.en: I was dead before I even came to this world.

records.en_original: No...
records.en_auxiliary: No...
records.en: No...

records.jp: 勇希ちゃんが、死んでる……？
records.en_original: Yuki died...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki died...?
records.en: Yuki-chan died...?

records.jp: ま、待ってよ！<CR>そんな……なんで！？　おかしいよこんなのっ！
records.en_original: W-wait! That's... Why?! That's not possible!
records.en_auxiliary: W-wait! That's... Why?! That's not possible!
records.en: W-wait! That's... Why?! That's not possible!

records.jp: う、嘘だよね……？<CR>勇希ちゃんが、死んでる、なんて……
records.en_original: Th-that can't be true, can it...? She can't actually be...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that can't be true, can it...? She can't actually be...
records.en: I-it's a lie, right...? Yuki-chan can't be dead...

records.jp: 嘘にしては、たちが悪すぎるよ……
records.en_original: If this is a joke, it isn't very funny...
records.en_auxiliary: If this is a joke, it isn't very funny...
records.en: If this is a joke, it isn't very funny...

records.jp: じ、じゃあ本当に金城さんは、亡くなって……！？
records.en_original: Th-then she really passed away...?!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-then she really passed away...?!
records.en: Th-then Kinjou-san really is dead...?!

records.jp: まさか、私たちも思い出せていないだけで、<CR>全員、死んでる……なんて……――
records.en_original: Does this mean that we're all dead and we just don't remember...?
records.en_auxiliary: Does this mean that we're all dead and we just don't remember...?
records.en: Does this mean that we're all dead and we just don't remember...?

records.jp: そんなわけないっ！！
records.en_original: Impossible!
records.en_auxiliary: Impossible!
records.en: Impossible!

records.jp: そんなわけ、ないって、思いたいのに……
records.en_original: That can't be... I don't want that...
records.en_auxiliary: That can't be... I don't want that...
records.en: That can't be... I don't want that...

records.jp: クソッ、全部勇希のせいだ……。<CR>こんな気持ちになるのも、全部、全部……
records.en_original: Damn it! This is all your fault, Yuki... This, these feelings I have for you, everything...
records.en_auxiliary: Damn it! This is all your fault, Yuki... This, these feelings I have for you, everything...
records.en: Damn it! This is all your fault, Yuki... This, these feelings I have for you, everything...

records.jp: 伶那さん……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...
records.en: Rena-san...

records.jp: ……それでも、向き合うって決めたんだ
records.en_original: But still, I've decided that I won't run away anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: But still, I've decided that I won't run away anymore.
records.en: But still, I've decided that I won't run away anymore.

records.jp: ――私の好きを、舐めるな……！
records.en_original: Don't you dare underestimate my love!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you dare underestimate my love!
records.en: Don't you dare underestimate my love!
